description: Multi-similarity metric-learning loss over unit-normalized embeddings, with relative-similarity pair mining and log-sum-exp weighting (Wang et al., §3.1 and §4.2 Eqs. (11)–(15); paper.txt:116-137,354-419; implementation in src/topologies/implementations/losses/multi_similarity.py:7-105).

examples.title: Train an embedding model with multi-similarity loss

name: Multi-similarity loss

parameters.additional parameters: **params accepts alpha, beta, lambda, and epsilon; unsupported keys raise ValueError
parameters.alpha: positive finite scalar weighting the positive log-sum-exp term (default 2.0; paper §5)
parameters.beta: positive finite scalar weighting the negative log-sum-exp term (default 50.0; paper §5)
parameters.epsilon: finite nonnegative relative-similarity mining margin (default 0.1; paper §4.2 Eqs. (11)–(12) and §5)
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because ignored-label semantics are not defined by the paper
parameters.lambda: finite similarity offset in the pair objective (default 1.0; paper §4.2 Eq. (15) and §5)
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point unit-normalized embedding tensor with shape [B, D] and nonempty batch and feature dimensions
parameters.reduction: none returns one term per anchor, mean averages anchor terms, or sum totals them (default mean)
parameters.targets: integral class IDs shaped [B]; finite integral-valued floating labels are also accepted
